gpu_peak_method: Maximum sampled by runner hardware_record every250 control steps (~5s) and on termination; not continuous hardware peak.
process_ram_peak_method: OS getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss high-water value; not whole-system RAM peak.
stdout_metrics_provenance: Parent/root reports these values extracted from stdout into its evidence/acceptance_summary.json; this audit directly verifies GPU/process-RAM fields in original result, not that separate stdout extraction.
